Class FieldDef

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.FieldDef
public final class FieldDef extends Object
Immutable definition of a single COBOL data item (field or group).

Corresponds to a DATA DIVISION entry like: 

  05 CUST-NAME PIC X(20).
A group item (no PIC) contains children and spans their combined storage. An elementary item has a PIC and occupies a specific byte range in the record buffer.
